versions.changelog:
v1.0.2 — Declare required env vars in metadata

- Added MSSQL_HOST, MSSQL_DB, MSSQL_USER, MSSQL_PASSWORD to requires.env
- Fixes manifest/metadata inconsistency flagged by ClawHub security scan

v1.0.1 — Security hardening + contract fix

- Password no longer exposed in process list (uses SQLCMDPASSWORD env var)
- MSSQL_TRUST_CERT defaults to no (certificate validation enabled)
- Output contract renamed to delimiter-separated text (not CSV) — docs, examples, and help text updated
- Fixed --out crash with filename-only paths
- Fixed separator line removal — now position-aware (line 2 only)
- Added --db flag for ad-hoc database override
Initial release — SQL Server queries and CSV export, no query restrictions, permissions at DB user level
